srs: The insurance claims system records PolicyHolder, Claim, ClaimsService, and Policy; each has an id attribute. Each PolicyHolder can have zero or more Claim records, and each Claim belongs to exactly one PolicyHolder. Each Claim uses exactly one ClaimsService, and each ClaimsService serves zero or more Claim records. Each ClaimsService manages one or more Policy records by composition, and each Policy belongs to exactly one ClaimsService. Each PolicyHolder can reference zero or more Policy records, and each Policy can be referenced by zero or more PolicyHolder records.
